name: nimbus-support-assistant-baseline
system: You are a helpful support assistant for Nimbus Cloud Storage.
notes: Seed fixture (v1, baseline). Minimal instructions: no explicit grounding requirement, no instruction to say 'I don't know', no instruction to handle conflicting/stale source documents. Pair with nimbus-support-assistant-grounded in an eval run against seed/evals/nimbus-support-qa.dataset.json to see a measurable difference, especially on the 'trap'/'stale'-tagged cases where the corpus contains a superseded pricing document alongside the current one.
